supported_claims: Whole-cohort evidence-guided construction without individual input executed under the fixed procedure.
All ten E1 Agent models numerically used at least one qualified relation.
E1 had smaller constructor-first mean absolute discrepancy for five of six prespecified analyses; CHNS BMI worsened.
Scientific analysis performance depends on endpoint, author and information condition.
Statistical comparator orderings are mixed and descriptive.
unsupported_claims: General superiority over statistical synthesis or other Agents
retain_counterexamples: CHNS E1 A03 conditional-age mean was negative.
ENSANUT E1 age was high and BMI effects low relative to the sample reference.
Statistical CHNS glucose and ENSANUT conditional BMI had smaller discrepancies than corresponding Agent constructions.
reference_status: Previously exposed development samples; uncertain case-specific sample estimates, no equivalence threshold.
next: Manuscript and public reviewed artifact synchronization; finish citations/declarations before submission.
